content.text: Verifying final file dimensions and the landscape re-render:

All three renders are clean. Final check summary:

| File | Size | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `square.png` | 1080×1080 | ✅ |
| `landscape.png` | 1920×1080 | ✅ |
| `story.png` | 1080×1920 | ✅ |

**What I built** — a single `card.html` driven by `?size=` with three hand-tuned layout variants sharing one design system (`#0F1226` ground, white text, `#7C5CFF` accent, Inter loaded via `@font-face` from the local TTF).

- **Square** — header, speaker row (circle + name/role), 70px title over 4 lines, hairline rule + footer.
- **Landscape** — two columns: an 84px title on the left, a 360px portrait with name/role stacked beneath on the right; full-width header and footer band.
- **Story** — fully centred stack with a 400px portrait and an 88px title; slack distributed evenly via paired `margin-top:auto` so there's no dead zone.

**Verification** — rather than eyeballing, I ran a geometric audit in the page for each size: every descendant's bounding box was compared against the padded safe area (left/top/right/bottom) and checked for scroll overflow. All three returned an empty defect list. I also confirmed the avatar is exactly square in CSS pixels at every size (168², 360², 400²) so `border-radius:50%` is a true circle, measured the nowrap strings against their containers (the landscape name was hitting its column edge at 40px, so I dropped it to 38px for clearance), and verified the written PNGs decode at exactly the requested pixel dimensions.

Two layout fixes along the way: the speaker block initially inherited a horizontal flex row inside the narrow landscape column, and the square/story variants had 160–460px of dead space above the footer, which I resolved by enlarging the titles and letting auto margins share the remaining space.
